pages.text: Talks to the ORSA relay. Listens for free broadcasts; transmits for supplies, maps and records.

pages.title: Building
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Console$(): a grid machine, linked with the $(l:power/binder)Binder$(/l)$(li)$(bold)Dish$(): open sky straight above, within $(bold)8 blocks$() of the console$(br2)The console uses the nearest dish with sky.

pages.title: Parts
pages.text: The $(bold)Signal Processor$() and $(bold)Feed Horn$() can't be crafted.$(li)Monitoring station back rooms: one of each$(li)Ruined reactor sites: a Feed Horn$(li)Uplink supply drops

pages.title: The Dish
pages.text: Mining it returns it, so you can move it.$(br2)$(danger)Blizzards can tear it away, and explosions destroy it.$() Either way it's gone; a new one needs another Feed Horn.

pages.name: Uplink Site
pages.text: Dish on a mast under open sky, console within 8 blocks.

pages.title: Console
pages.text: Copper, glass, iron, redstone and a Signal Processor.

pages.title: Dish
pages.text: Iron and a Feed Horn on an iron block.
